name: @repo/favicon-search
description: A keyboard-driven search field that shows each result's favicon, with a combobox listbox and highlighted matches.

useCases: Site/URL search with recognizable favicons per result
Command palette style search with a ⌘K shortcut hint
Bookmark or history picker with keyboard navigation
compositionHints: Pass loading while an async search request is in flight
Combine with your own debounced search call via onValueChange
Favicons fall back to Google's s2 favicon service, then a monogram tile
